system.description: • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a damage multiplier (double at 1st level, rising to sextuple at 20th — see the Rogue Progression Table). Usable once per round. Requires a successful Move Silently or Hide check, attacking from behind a target with a discernible back, using a close-quarters melee weapon shorter than your arm. Multiply the weapon's damage dice only.

activities.name: Back Attack
activities.text: From behind after a successful Hide or Move Silently, gain Advantage and multiply the weapon's damage dice; see the Rogue Progression Table.

rules.value: Back Attack: multiply the weapon's damage dice (x2 at 1st, up to x6 at 20th, see Rogue Progression Table).
